snippet.title: Dr Goo (PC) Gameplay
snippet.description:
The Very Easiest game that can be finished within a minute or so.
▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀
Dr. Goo is a humorous side-scrolling game featuring Dr. Goo, a heroic glob of gelatinous, sticky green stuff. With incredible graphics, fun gameplay and an engaging story line, you'll quickly fall in love with Dr. Goo and will see why they had to make 2 sequels, both of which are ALSO included on this compliation!
▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀ 
Where you can download Dr. Goo
► https://archive.org/details/Dr-Goo
(Can't find the other link from Droo.8m.com due to the site being down. but I still have a copy of this)
▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀
► Music is: ingame
► Song By: Josh Bender
▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀
